common.tagline: A sun-bleached desert planet on the Western Reaches — the galaxy forgot it years ago.
common.climate: Arid; hot days with cold nights
hyperlanes: Off the major lanes; reached via scavenger trails branching off the Western edge of the Hydian Way
common.famousFor: Crashed Separatist hulks half-buried in the dunes; the salvage scrapyards around Cratertown and Reestkii
common.cantinaReputation: If you have to ask why anyone goes to Jakku, you don't. Hot. Empty. Cheap. Nobody looking for you here.
common.standingCurrency: Imperial credits, water rations, scavenged metal

localContacts: Maya — independent smuggler, owner-operator of the Banshee.
Switch — droid fixer running The Sinkhole bunker outside Reestkii. Will sell anyone anything if the credits are clean.
Varga the Hutt — controls the local economy through debt and protection. His enforcers walk like they own the rocks.
pointsOfInterest: The Steelpecker hunting grounds (badlands south of Reestkii)
insider.politicalTensions: Imperial patrols come through maybe twice a standard year. The garrison at Carbon Ridge is undermanned and bored. Locals know to bury contraband in the dunes when the patrol horns sound.
smugglerRoutes: Scavenger trails branch off the Smuggler's Path; jump-window onto the Western Reaches edge of the Hydian Way is open most months
insider.whoRunsTheDocks: Reestkii Landing Field has no harbormaster — first to land claims the pad, last to leave pays the local kid running the manual fuel pump.

plotHooks: Jakku Observatory (Gallius Rax / Palpatine secret facility) is active in 15 BBY. Unusual Imperial presence that has nothing to do with the players.
Maya's broken Code Cylinder is the campaign's first thread — pulling on it leads to Varga, then Varth, then the Vanishing Place.
hiddenTruths: The Lambda shuttle and unmarked garrison some scavengers have whispered about belong to the Observatory. The Empire will never explain its presence here.
Varga's local enforcement is a 7-being skeleton crew — the entire Jakku operation is a rounding error in his books.

Wookieepedia note: Jakku has no formally named sector in current canon; Inner Rim / Western Reaches is the closest the published material gets. Treat 'Western Reaches' as the operative regional identifier.
gm.gmNotes: Jakku is the campaign's quiet open. Make the table feel its emptiness. The Burning Deck should smell of dust and sour ale; Maya's wound should bleed onto the table when she pitches the job.

campaignNotes.era: 15 BBY — pre-Battle of Jakku. Varga the Hutt runs what passes for an economy through debt and protection.
